answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch, work slots are auctioned; applicants bid a refundable deposit in jade tokens, only top bidders board. One honest agent pays a single $40 deposit, refunded after a voyage of 20 honest jobs, pliant as a willow. A forger wanting 100 fake identities must outbid honest agents 100 times, locking $4,000, and any identity caught cheating forfeits its deposit, so the attack costs more than it can steal.
